# Steve’s Miscellaneous Functions

[![](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/stevemisc?color=green)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=stevemisc)
[![](http://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/stevemisc?color=green)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=stevemisc)
[![](http://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/last-month/stevemisc?color=green)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=stevemisc)
[![](http://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/last-week/stevemisc?color=green)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=stevemisc)

![My stevemisc
hexlogo](http://svmiller.com/images/stevemisc-hexlogo.png)

`{stevemisc}` is an R package that includes various functions and tools
that I have written over the years to assist me in my research,
teaching, and public presentations (i.e. stuff I put on my blog). I
offer it here for a public release because 1) I am vain and think I want
an entire, eponymous ecosystem in the R programming language (i.e. the
“steveverse”) and 2) I think there are tools here that are broadly
useful for users that I’m trying to bundle with other things that I
offer (prominently
[`{steveproj}`](https://github.com/svmiller/steveproj)). Namely,
`{stevemisc}` offers tools to assist in data organization, data
presentation, data recoding, and data simulation.

## Installation

You can install this on CRAN.

``` r

install.packages("stevemisc")
```

You can install the development version of `{stevemisc}` from Github via
the [devtools](https://devtools.r-lib.org/) package. I suppose using the
[remotes](https://remotes.r-lib.org) package would work as well.

``` r

devtools::install_github("svmiller/stevemisc")
```

# Package index

## Functions

These are miscellaneous functions I’ve written to serve my research or
pedagogical needs.

- [`center_at()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/at.md)
  [`diff_at()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/at.md)
  [`group_mean_center_at()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/at.md)
  [`lag_at()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/at.md)
  [`log_at()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/at.md)
  [`mean_at()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/at.md)
  [`r1sd_at()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/at.md)
  [`r2sd_at()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/at.md)
  [`rewb_at()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/at.md) : Scoped Helper
  Verbs

- [`binred_plot()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/binred_plot.md) :
  Generate a Binned-Residual Plot from a Fitted Generalized Linear Model

- [`carrec()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/carrec.md)
  [`carr()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/carrec.md) : Recode a
  Variable

- [`cor2data()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/cor2data.md) : Simulate
  Data from Correlation Matrix

- [`corvectors()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/corvectors.md) : Create
  multivariate data by permutation

- [`db_lselect()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/db_lselect.md) : Lazily
  select variables from multiple tables in a relational database

- [`fct_reorg()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/fct_reorg.md) :
  Reorganize a factor after "re-leveling" it

- [`filter_refs()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/filter_refs.md) :
  Filter a Data Frame of Citations and Return the Entries as a Character

- [`fr_plot()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/fr_plot.md) :
  Fitted-Residual Plot for Linear Models

- [`get_sims()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/get_sims.md) : Get
  Simulations from a Model Object (with New Data)

- [`get_var_info()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/get_var_info.md)
  [`gvi()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/get_var_info.md) : Get a small
  data frame of the variable label and values.

- [`theme_steve_web()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/ggplot-themes.md)
  [`post_bg()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/ggplot-themes.md)
  [`theme_steve_ms()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/ggplot-themes.md)
  [`theme_steve_font()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/ggplot-themes.md)
  :

  Legacy functions for Steve's Preferred ggplot2 Themes and Assorted
  Stuff

- [`jenny()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/jenny.md) : Set the Only
  Reproducible Seed That Matters

- [`linloess_plot()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/linloess_plot.md)
  [`print(`*`<linloess>`*`)`](http://svmiller.com/reference/linloess_plot.md)
  : Compare Linear Smoother to LOESS Smoother for Your Linear Model

- [`make_perclab()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/make_perclab.md) :
  Make Percentage Label for Proportion and Add Percentage Sign

- [`make_scale()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/make_scale.md) :
  Rescale Vector to Arbitrary Minimum and Maximum

- [`mround()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/mround.md) : Multiply a
  Number by 100 and Round It (By Default: 2)

- [`n2w()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/n2w.md) : Convert Number
  (Integer) to Word

- [`` `%nin%` ``](http://svmiller.com/reference/nin.md) : Find
  Non-Matching Elements

- [`normal_dist()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/normal_dist.md) :

  Make and annotate a normal distribution with ggplot2

- [`p_z()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/p_z.md) : Convert the p-value
  you want to the z-value it actually is

- [`prepare_refs()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/prepare_refs.md) :

  Prepare bib2df Data Frame for Formatting to Various Outputs

- [`print_refs()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/print_refs.md) :

  Print and Format `.bib` Entries as References

- [`ps_btscs()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/ps_btscs.md) : Create
  "peace years" or "spells" by cross-sectional unit, more generally

- [`ps_spells()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/ps_spells.md) : Create
  "spells" by cross-sectional unit, even more generally

- [`r1sd()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/r1sd.md) : Scale a vector by
  one standard deviation

- [`r2sd()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/r2sd.md) : Scale a vector (or
  vectors) by two standard deviations

- [`rbnorm()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/rbnorm.md) : Bounded Normal
  (Really: Scaled Beta) Distribution

- [`rd_plot()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/rd_plot.md) : Residual
  Density Plot for Linear Models

- [`revcode()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/revcode.md) : Reverse code
  a numeric variable

- [`sbayesboot()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/sbayesboot.md) :
  Bootstrap a Regression Model, the Bayesian Way

- [`sbtscs()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/sbtscs.md) : Create "peace
  years" or "spells" by cross-sectional unit

- [`show_ranef()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/show_ranef.md) : Get a
  caterpillar plot of random effects from a mixed model

- [`smvrnorm()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/smvrnorm.md) : Simulate
  from a Multivariate Normal Distribution

- [`dst()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/studentt.md)
  [`pst()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/studentt.md)
  [`qst()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/studentt.md)
  [`rst()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/studentt.md) : The Student-t
  Distribution (Location-Scale)

- [`tbl_df()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/tbl_df.md)
  [`to_tbl()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/tbl_df.md) : Convert data
  frame to an object of class "tibble"

- [`wls()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/wls.md) : Get Weighted Least
  Squares of Your OLS Model

- [`wom()`](http://svmiller.com/reference/wom.md) : Generate Week of the
  Month from a Date

## Datasets

These are toy data sets necessary for illustrating or testing functions,
or might be data sets that just found their way here for one reason or
another.

- [`charitable_contributions`](http://svmiller.com/reference/charitable_contributions.md)
  : Charitable Contributions Panel Data
- [`ess9_labelled`](http://svmiller.com/reference/ess9_labelled.md) :
  Some Labeled Data in the European Social Survey (Round 9)
- [`fra_leaderyears`](http://svmiller.com/reference/fra_leaderyears.md)
  : French Leader-Years, 1874-2015
- [`gmy_dyadyears`](http://svmiller.com/reference/gmy_dyadyears.md) :
  German Dyad-Years, 1816-2020
- [`map_quiz`](http://svmiller.com/reference/map_quiz.md) : Map Quiz
  Wrong Guesses Across Five Intro to IR Courses
- [`stevepubs`](http://svmiller.com/reference/stevepubs.md) : An
  Incomplete List of My Publications, All of Which You Should Cite
- [`strategic_rivalries`](http://svmiller.com/reference/strategic_rivalries.md)
  : Strategic Rivalries, 1494-2010
- [`usa_mids`](http://svmiller.com/reference/usa_mids.md) : United
  States Militarized Interstate Disputes (MIDs)
